verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can "analyze files" and "read files, analyze data, and summarize findings". They also reference uploading files to a cloud conversation in Work on the Web. A community comment praises the file-upload/interpretation capability. Accuracy is the weak point: one hands-on user notes it "often generates plausible but not quite right answers" and is "bad at numbers", which tempers the "accurate" part of the story without concretely contradicting file analysis. Missing for 10: explicit docs on uploading and analyzing PDFs and spreadsheets specifically (the document/spreadsheet/PDF items describe drafting output, not analyzing uploads), supported formats and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of accurate document and spreadsheet analysis.
